title_sq: Ambient/zyra ne shitje ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha ne afersi te Procredit Bank ne Tirane (ID 4161069)
description_sq:
Ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha ne afersi te Procredit Bank, shitet ambient/zyra, siperfaqe 990 m², kati 2 ne nje pallat te ri. Ambienti organizohet ne nje dhome(holl) ne katin e pare qe lidhet me shkalle me katin lart, dhe nje ambient open space ne katin 2, ballkone ne te gjitha anet. Ambienti eshte i pershtatshem per nje shumllojshmeri aktivitetesh si, klinike, zyra, call center, konvikte, ku kati pare mund te sherbeje edhe si reception.
Cmimi 1000000 Euro
title_en: Premises/offices for sale on Dritan Hoxha street near Procredit Bank in Tirana (ID 4161069)
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha street near Procredit Bank, premises/office for sale, surface area 990 m², 2nd floor in a new building. The environment is organized in a room (hall) on the first floor connected by stairs to the upper floor, and an open space environment on the 2nd floor, balconies on all sides. The environment is suitable for a variety of activities such as clinics, offices, call centers, dormitories, where the first floor can also serve as a reception. The price is 1,000,000 Euros
